# Guide: add Arc mainnet to MetaMask and fund it with USDC

A 250 to 400 word step-by-step guide for a first-time user:

1. Add Arc mainnet to MetaMask: chain id 5042, currency USDC with 18 decimals, an RPC listed at https://docs.arc.io/arc/references/rpc-endpoints.
2. Get USDC onto Arc from Base or another chain.
3. Point out that USDC is also the gas token, so nothing else is needed.

Screenshots or clearly named steps.
